manabox_appstore.text: ‎ManaBox MTG App - App Store Search Today Games Apps Arcade Platform iPhone iPad Mac Vision Watch TV ManaBox MTG Boost your deck building Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS. Share 1.7K Ratings 4.6 Age Rating 13+ Years Category Productivity Developer SkillDevs S.C. Language EN + 13 More Size 175.2 MB iPhone, iPad Your MTG toolkit. Search every card, check prices, scan and organize your collection, build and share decks, and keep your cards right in your pocket. FEATURES: - Powerful search with filters of all cards and sets, all offline - Scan cards with the camera - Up to date prices from the main stores and marketplaces: TCGplayer, Card Kingdom, Star City Games, Cardmarket... - Improve your deck building, check the value of your decks and view multiple stats (Mana Curve, Mana Production...) - Organize your card collection in sorted binders and lists - Powerful deck simulator to test and improve your decks - Complete card information with up to date rules and legalities - Easily share decks with your friends - Track your favorite cards - Feed with multiple Magic: the Gathering articles - Trade tool ManaBox is an unofficial companion tool for Magic: The Gathering (MTG) players. With ManaBox you can search through all cards and sets without exception for FREE. ManaBox allows you to access up to date market data from different stores and marketplaces so you always know the value of your cards or look at the prices of the cards you would like to get. Easily digitalize your collection with the built in card scanner and have it available in your pocket at all times. Keep all your decks organized inside the app and place them in folders if you prefer. You can also share links to them that can be opened in any browser. You can share any card you want with your friends as well as a link to the marketplace of your choice. View any set and any card in MTG history, all in one app. The always up to date database means you will never miss any recently released set or card. ManaBox includes a powerful trade tool that allows you to do better trades, faster and fairer. Search easily between different sets and choose the specific card version you want to trade. We’re continuously working on improving the app, we’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions at manabox@skilldevs.com. All prices in the app come as is from the stores but it's possible that some small differences exist. This is because of the update frequency between what's shown in the app and what you can see in the store's website. Currently ManaBox has support for the following stores and marketplaces: - TCGplayer - Cardmarket - Card Kingdom - Star City Games - Cardhoarder - Mana Pool Magic: The Gathering is copyrighted by Wizards of the Coast and ManaBox is not affiliated in any way with Wizards of the Coast nor Hasbro, Inc. This app offers subscriptions. They're available (in USD) for $2.49 monthly or $22.99 yearly. ManaBox subscriptions will renew within 24 hours of the subscription period ending, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. Manage at any times through Account Settings in iTunes. Terms and Privacy Policy can be found at https://manabox.app/termsofservice and https://manabox.app/privacy, respectively. more Ratings & Reviews 4.6 out of 5 1.7K Ratings The Last Organization/Inventory App You'll Need 02/24/2023 PHM, TDS, WT, YZ, TS Let me start by saying that I have yet to find a single real issue with this app in the two or so years I've had it and used it on a near daily basis. I've recently reached out regarding a small "issue" I'd come across that was woefully minute in its impact and really was used as more of an impetus to sing the devs' praise than anything else. Every update has added useful, functional features, streamlined the ease of use and been well notated in its improvements. The "issue" I'd provided feedback was met with a very quick, professional, and informative response. I am thoroughly impressed with this app and the fact I've not once encountered anything resembling an actual problem in the time I've used it. In a world that throws everything away after it loses its luster, it's rare to find anything that remains functional, useful, and enjoyable after 5 minutes, let alone years. I look forward to years more of continued use and cannot state emphatically enough how great this app is for what it does, so I'll end with this: the state of Magic: the Gathering itself would be nowhere near as dire and uncertain as it is if Hasbro and WotC were as attentive to their product as the devs are to this app, they would do well to take notes. The amount of relief this product has brought me is tremendous. Dragon Shield has set themselves apart from others in a number of ways with this scanner. The seamless accessibility and ease of navigation is definitely noteworthy. I am able to customize the way I store and organize my cards, keep track of the decks that I have my cards in, and monitor the ebbing and flowing values of my individual cards, as well as my collection as a whole. This app has everything I could possibly need, except ONE feature (which I hope to see added, eventually). The only thing this app is lacking is a way to add MTG products to your inventory, aside from individual cards, that would otherwise be for sale on sites such as TCG Player, Card Kingdom, etc. It would be helpful to keep track of my inventory and the value of items such as unopened precons or booster boxes. I’m not sure how realistic or easy it would be to add such a feature, but I would love to see it! I've already recommended the app to my entire playgroup, and even offered to help them get their collections organized. Absolutely top product here. Thank you for recommending the app to your playgroup. If anything comes up don't hesitate to let us know! :) Great app, only one flaw 04/21/2022 Bryce Richendollar The app is absolutely amazing! I’m a very new player, having only played for 3 weeks now, this app makes it much easier to see exactly what a card can do and allows me to see everything in my collection at a moments notice. The scan feature is truly fast, often times taking less than half a second to get the card scanned. There is a few things to be desired however. The scan is so insanely fast that it often scans incorrectly. While it’ll be accurate in the name of the card (forest land for instance) it’ll often get the print date and/or art incorrect. While this doesn’t make that big of a difference for someone who mostly cares about the value of the cards, for people who collect them for the art like me, it can be a hassle and end up being more time consuming trying to find the correct art and release year. While this can be annoying, it’s less of a flaw and more of a trade off in my opinion.The big flaw is how I am unable to chance the price of purchase of these cards or decks. Personally I mostly purchase pre made commander decks. I may have only spent $35-$40 on the entire deck, however the app states the price of purchase as the actual value of the cards at the time of scanning which ends up showing that I “spent” $75 on a deck when in reality I spent $35 on the full deck. I feel like this would be an insanely easy fix, simply adding a “change purchase price” button for the decks that were scanned into the inventory section of the app would instantly make this a 5 star review!!!Thank you dragon shield, this is overall an AMAZING app for a new player and I fully plan to use this app for the foreseeable future Developer Response Thank you so much for the amazing review and we hope that you keep enjoying our app as well as we would like to welcome you to the game as this is a game we all love here in the team!Regarding the feedback provided we will definitely bring this to our development team.
